disclosures: Scenario impacts compare sealed same-context boards and do not rewrite the baseline artifact.
Interaction effects belong to combined scenarios and need not equal isolated impacts.
Typed scenario attribution distinguishes direct raw/evidence changes, cohort normalization revaluation, and unchanged profiles.
Every trial perturbs registered raw profile inputs and rebuilds the complete cohort through the canonical Window scorer.
Active-shock uncertainty is a bounded symmetric triangular distribution around the conditional mean; occurrence probability is sampled separately and the inactive outcome may carry its own raw delta.
Shared correlation keys coordinate occurrence only; amplitudes remain shock-specific.
The central impact uses probability-weighted expected raw deltas and is not substituted for the seeded distribution.
Pane distributions are omitted when the sealed baseline withholds that pane score; missing panes are never coerced to zero.
